description:
Fork a Control Debugger trace at a selected cursor and continue deterministically.

This writes fork transcript evidence but does not call a provider. It uses the
deterministic scripted continuation that the Ralph read-before-edit UI path
uses by default.

policy_overlay.description: Policy overlay JSON object to apply before deterministic continuation.

name: fork_control_debugger_cursor

description: List built-in Control Debugger counterfactual examples.
name: list_control_debugger_examples

description: Load Control Debugger trace events by receipt id or session id.

receipt_id.description: Receipt id whose full-session transcript should be loaded.

session_id.description: Trace session id to load directly.

name: load_control_debugger_trace

description:
Record a built-in Control Debugger counterfactual example.

This writes receipt and transcript evidence for the selected example. The
built-in examples use deterministic scripted continuation and do not require a
paid provider call.

example_id.description: Built-in example id, for example read-before-edit or output-contract.

name: record_control_debugger_example

description: Replay a Control Debugger trace up to a selected cursor without a provider call.
name: replay_control_debugger_cursor

description:
Save selected Control Debugger trace evidence as a pinned simulator case.

This is write-capable. The selected trace events can contain sensitive
session metadata, so saved scenario packs must be reviewed before sharing.

pattern_id.description: Workbench policy pattern id for the simulator case.

name: save_control_debugger_evidence
